paper.title: Machine Learned Equations for Vertical Mixing Coefficients in the Ocean Surface Boundary Layer

methods.canonical_name: ePBL_EQ (ePBL with GP / least-squares discovered diffusivity equations)
methods.family_raw: equation discovery (genetic programming and least squares fitting) embedded in the ePBL first-order scheme
methods.architecture_note: Closed-form expressions with O(10) fitted coefficients (Table 1), distilled from neural network predictions, replacing F1 and F2 in ePBL. Forme fonctionnelle découverte par programmation génétique puis moindres carrés: règles 6 et 8.

methods.canonical_name: ePBL_NN (ePBL with neural-network shape function and velocity scale)
methods.architecture_note: Architecture of the networks is not described in this paper (see Sane et al., 2023). Réseau inséré dans le schéma ePBL: la règle 5 classe le réseau, pas le système couplé.

experiments.task_raw: equation discovery distilled from neural networks for ePBL shape function and velocity scale
experiments.target_variable: shape function g(sigma) and velocity scale v0 / vh0
experiments.note: Equations are obtained by GP and least squares fitting on neural-network predictions; no gradient-training hyperparameters apply. Coefficients fitted with Python Scipy curve_fit for Equation 8.

experiments.task_raw: neural networks trained on GLS data to predict ePBL shape function and velocity scale
experiments.target_variable: shape function g(sigma) and velocity scale v0
experiments.note: Training details are delegated to Sane et al. (2023); split said to be identical to that work.
